headline: EOG Resources Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: EOG Resources reported third-quarter results that surpassed analyst expectations for both earnings per share and total revenue.
why: EOG Resources is a leading US-based energy company focused on crude oil and natural gas exploration. Its financial results are closely watched as a proxy for the performance of the US shale industry.

impacts.name: EOG Resources
impacts.why: Beating earnings and revenue estimates is generally viewed positively by investors.
